rules: Every offer must have price, estimated delivery cost, gross margin and break-even target.
No proposal can be sent without margin check.
Build time is a cost even when agents do the work.
Any custom promise above the pilot scope must be quoted separately.
Paid data, SERP, proxy, video, voice or ads tools require CFO approval before spend.

packages.name: 72h AI Automation Pilot
packages.notes: Scope must stay narrow: one useful automation, QA, handoff and maintenance CTA.

packages.name: Monthly Maintenance Basic
packages.notes: Use for monitoring, small changes and support.

packages.name: Parts Seller OS MVP Audit
packages.notes: Inventory, location, pricing and listing workflow map plus first automation slice.

packages.name: 72h AI Ads Factory Sprint
packages.notes: Deliver 10 ad variants, hooks, CTA, scripts, prompt set, QA and next-test recommendation. Tool spend must stay zero until first paid sprint or CFO approval.

packages.name: Creative Iteration Retainer
packages.notes: Monthly ad/content variants, QA, landing copy refresh and learning loop.

packages.name: Data Intelligence Monitoring
packages.notes: Competitor, price or lead monitoring using allowed public sources with provenance and QA. Paid data providers require CFO approval.

sprint_financial_targets.build_discipline_rule: No extra feature build without either live demo proof or revenue pipeline movement.

cost_log.reason: Budget reserved for first paid pilot delivery/checklist creation.
Capped dashboard/demo build before sales proof.
Budget cap for first sample creative sprint before paid ads/tool spend.
